verified_facts.text: The Remarkables Terrace offers alfresco dining overlooking native gardens with views of Lake Wakatipu and the surrounding mountains.
verified_facts.excerpt: Refined alfresco dining overlooking native gardens and unrivalled panoramic views of Lake Wakatipu and the surrounding mountains.

verified_facts.text: Double Rock Farm in the Kawarau Gorge grows organic berries, quince, hazelnuts and mulberries exclusively for the lodge's kitchen.
verified_facts.excerpt: Nestled in Kawarau Gorge, Double Rock Farm grows organic berries, quince, hazelnuts, and mulberries exclusively for Rosewood Matakauri's culinary delights.

verified_facts.text: Bees kept at the lodge produce honey that is used in its cuisine.
verified_facts.excerpt: Bees at Rosewood Matakauri thrive amidst native flora, creating distinctive honey that captures the essence of the land and enhances the resort’s cuisine.

verified_facts.text: A garden of rare produce, just steps from the restaurant, inspires the lodge's dining.
verified_facts.excerpt: A curated garden brimming with rare produce inspires our dining experiences. Discover a world of flavour, grown just steps away.

verified_facts.text: The Dining Room serves a la carte breakfast and dinner menus built on local seasonal produce.
verified_facts.excerpt: Guests staying at Rosewood Matakauri can look forward to breakfast and dinner menus that celebrate local seasonal produce with clean, fresh flavours in an à la carte menu.

verified_facts.text: Private dining ranges from fireside dinners in the Library to gatherings in the Main Dining Room.
verified_facts.excerpt: From fireside dinners in the Library to elegant gatherings in the Main Dining Room, Matakauri offers refined private dining experiences

verified_facts.text: The Grand Lake View Suite has a mountain view, an open fireplace and a private balcony.
verified_facts.excerpt: marries ultra-luxury, contemporary interiors with a truly spectacular mountain view, open fireplace and private balcony.

verified_facts.text: The Lake View Two Bedroom Villa has two ensuite bedrooms and a living area that overlooks the mountains.
verified_facts.excerpt: An intimate personal hideaway with two ensuite bedrooms and a spacious living area that overlooks the region's most iconic mountains

verified_facts.text: The Matakauri Four Bedroom Villa has an open fireplace, a fully equipped kitchen, an infinity-edge jacuzzi and a sheltered courtyard.
verified_facts.excerpt: Luxuriously appointed four-bedroom residence with large living and dining area with open fireplace, fully equipped kitchen with infinity edge jacuzzi and sheltered courtyard

verified_facts.text: The lodge arranges scenic helicopter trips to Milford Sound.
verified_facts.excerpt: Embark on a heli adventure to Milford Sound, soaring above dramatic fiords, lush rainforests, and cascading waterfalls, with the chance to spot native wildlife.

verified_facts.text: Heli-skiing and heli-boarding in the backcountry can be arranged in winter.
verified_facts.excerpt: Explore pristine backcountry terrain and untouched powder on a heli-ski or heli-boarding adventure in Queenstown

verified_facts.text: Winery tours to Gibbston Valley can be arranged.
verified_facts.excerpt:
Winery Tours

Gibbston Valley

verified_facts.text: The lodge offers stargazing under New Zealand's dark southern sky.
verified_facts.excerpt: With New Zealand’s celebrated dark sky, stargazing here is a transformative experience.

verified_facts.text: Guests can take a gourmet picnic hamper of local food and wine out into the landscape.
verified_facts.excerpt: Experience the spectacular natural landscape with a gourmet picnic hamper filled with a curated selection of local food and wine.

verified_facts.text: The lodge sits on the shore of Lake Wakatipu just outside Queenstown's town center.
verified_facts.excerpt: When arriving at Matakauri's regal grounds, just outside the town center, that lake view is firmly in place

verified_facts.text: Rooms have floor-to-ceiling windows with lake views from bed.
verified_facts.excerpt: just wait till you see it through the resort's floor-to-ceiling windows from bed

verified_facts.text: The lodge faces The Remarkables mountain range across the lake.
verified_facts.excerpt: facing out to The Remarkables (yup, that's the name of the mountain range across the lake

verified_facts.text: Conde Nast Traveler finds the restaurant a little formal and suggests eating in town if you do not want a three-course dinner every night.
verified_facts.excerpt: It is a tad formal so if you're not feeling like a three-course meal each night, you are better off eating in the town.

verified_facts.text: Conde Nast Traveler notes the lodge could benefit from more amenities.
verified_facts.excerpt: It could benefit from extra amenities but the lake is so spectacular there may not be a need to distract from it.

verified_facts.text: The concierge can organize private wine tastings in the Otago wine country and helicopter rides to the peaks across the lake.
verified_facts.excerpt: Anything you would want to do in the greater environs can be organized through the concierge, including private wine tasting in the Otago Winelands and helicopter rides to the peaks across the lake.

verified_facts.text: Service follows a traditional silver-service approach.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Robertson Lodges follow a traditional, silver service approach
